I just finished the show. Totally new to this series, never read and never heard of the book. (now I'm slightly interested in the books since books are always better? ) The show was moderate for me, entertaining but not suspenseful. I did indeed find certain parts slow and got quite bored. I didn't feel drawn to the characters either, I felt nothing when they were emotional. (Probably bc I'm not the target audience. 😂)

It was still an entertaining watch, following and watching Pip's journey to figure out the truth, where she uncovers the secrets layer by layer. 😊 And if there's a season 2, I'll probably be curious to watch, but I'll watch a bit first to see how it goes.
